object_description: four-story three-wing building extending into the landscape
design_condition: The low, landscape-extending building is oriented between the surrounding development and the existing school, creating a sequence of open-space chambers and a strong central outdoor area.

positive.statement: The volumetry responds harmoniously to both the large and smaller scales of the school complex.
The settlement creates a sequence of different open-space chambers that complements the existing structure.
The exterior design and vegetation concept are convincing in their stringent clarity.
The climate-effective measures improve the local climate and promote biodiversity.
The path connections are clear and provide welcome added value.
The three-part complex has a strong center from which the different uses are developed.
The basic shape allows uses to be separated where this is desired.
The clusters are effectively organized around a common center, with group rooms accessible from both corridor and classroom.
The structural clarity results in an impressively simple building that harmoniously complements the existing school complex.

negative.statement: The spatial proportions of the group rooms should be checked.
Some basement workrooms are only illuminated via the gymnasium, which is viewed critically.
The jury was unable to understand why the glass balustrades were proposed.
